name: US Food Recall Monitor
description: Logs FDA and USDA FSIS food recalls, with region derived from distribution. One dataset drives a desktop dashboard, an iPhone home-screen app and an Excel workbook. Static pages on GitHub Pages; the repository is public.

choices.choice: Keep native <select> elements for the filter and year fields, for screen-reader and mobile-picker support. Labels sit above the fields.
Outlined text field with a visible "Search" label above it; the placeholder is a hint only. Matches the outlined selects (one text-field variant per region).

Pages open to an empty state with one primary action (refresh or load a file). Sample rows are never shown; on a failed live fetch the mobile app shows an error state, or the last published snapshot if one exists.
Native <progress> on the mobile Refresh: indeterminate from 200 ms, determinate (sources finished of 2) after 5 s. Start, finish and failure are announced through a polite live region.
A loaded file must be an array of objects with recall_id, agency and classification, or it is rejected and the current data is kept. Every field is HTML-escaped and only https links render.
Cells starting with = + - @ tab or CR are prefixed with an apostrophe.
Not applicable: the tool keeps no work in browser storage.
Reuse the 24dp medium-and-up margin; the spec values for these window size classes are not verified.

notes: Not declared: stores-data (no browser storage), has-destructive-actions (loading a file replaces only the in-memory view and a failed load keeps current data), has-intro (the Add to Home Screen tip is not an intro), shares-links, shares-files.
Consider-tier items not yet built, pending the owner: 404 page (E26), dismissible Add to Home Screen tip (E8), undo after loading a file (X7).
Large (1200-1599) and extra-large (>=1600) desktop layouts only widen the content column; the mobile app keeps a fixed 840px reading column on purpose.
